about_the_game:
After the events of the first game, the player enters therapy to process their trauma.

Upon arriving at the asylum, things don't go according to plan. A storm and the resulting power outage lead to events that will change their life forever.

Traverse the asylum in search of answers, collect items that will take you to other rooms of the asylum to find out what's really going on here, but beware, the danger is cunning and always after you.

Will you manage to escape the asylum alive? Or will you perish in a dark corner of the asylum's basement...

Features:

  • First 10-15 minutes of the game

  • Psychological Horror

  • Collect items and use them to progress

  • Standalone story; playing the first game is not required

  • Blood, gore and violence

content_descriptors.notes: Blood, gore and violence not suitable for all age groups
